# wisp-science v1.26.0 — GPUI Preview Builds

**Each release now includes a downloadable preview of the GPUI desktop for macOS, Windows and Linux, next to the WebView installers.** The preview has been restyled and now covers most WebView pages. R figures get the same layout checks as Python figures, Word tracked changes can edit text inside tables, and the research assistant can start a new discussion without opening another conversation.

## GPUI desktop preview

- The release assets now include one GPUI archive per platform. Nothing is installed: unpack it and run the program. It can live beside the WebView desktop because it has its own name, macOS bundle identifier and data folder.
  - macOS: `wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_aarch64.app.zip` and `_x64.app.zip`, signed and notarized.
  - Windows: `wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_x64.zip`, Authenticode-signed.
  - Linux: `wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_amd64.tar.gz`, unsigned. It needs Vulkan and an X11 or Wayland session.
- **It is still a preview.** The WebView installers remain the supported desktop, and the preview is not offered as an in-app update. Its update check opens the release page. See [GPUI desktop](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/gpui-desktop.md#preview-downloads) and the [parity ledger](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/gpui-parity.md).
- Most WebView features have been ported to the preview: the journey graph, side panel, pictures, archive, hosts and timers, paper evidence, import, the browser, centre documents, side questions, interpreters on SSH hosts, terminal input and selection, and mentions.
- It has a new "lab record" look: warm paper tones, serif titles, a reading column and a shared set of icons. Entries open with a line showing their number and time instead of a side gutter. Imported Codex file citations appear as links, and a finished turn shows the model's final answer.
- Windows: a crash when opening conversations is fixed, the window bar is drawn by the app, and the window control icons are corrected.

## Figures, documents and the assistant

- **R figures are checked before they are presented.** The `figure-style` skill now includes an R helper, `save_checked_figure`. It refuses blank or missing files, overlapping text and labels that run past the edge, then saves crops of each panel so the agent can look at the figure and fix it. See [skills](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/skills.md).
- **Word tracked changes can edit text inside table cells,** including nested tables. `read_docx` now reports where each paragraph sits, for example `table 1 row 2 cell 2`. Changes to a table's structure, text boxes and content controls are still refused. See [DOCX revisions](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/docx-revisions.md).
- **The research assistant has a New discussion button.** It clears what the model remembers while keeping the earlier messages visible above a divider. From WeChat, send `/new`. See [research assistant](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/research-assistant.md).

## Fixes

- When a damaged project database is restored from a backup copy or rebuilt empty, the project now shows a banner the next time you open it, even if the repair happened in the background. The banner stays until you close it. See [upgrade backups](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/upgrade-backups.md).
- The browser extension's side panel (0.5.1) has an **Allow for this chat** button, so it no longer asks for approval on every browser tool call. A tab shared with a project stays shared while it is open, even if it briefly visits another page such as `chrome://extensions`.
- Agents started by `delegate_tasks` without a tool-call budget now follow **Maximum agent iterations per turn** instead of a fixed limit of 100 rounds. A turn that stops at that limit shows an **Open settings** button that takes you to the setting. Note: if you set this value below 100, those agents now stop earlier.

## Downloads

- **macOS**: signed and notarized DMGs for Apple Silicon and Intel, with in-app updates for compatible installations.
- **Windows**: MSI and NSIS installers, signed with an SSL.com certificate.
- **Linux**: deb and AppImage packages for x86_64 and aarch64.
- **GPUI preview**: the four `wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_*` archives above.
- **Mobile**: the signed [Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.26.0/wisp-science_1.26.0_android.apk) installs over the previous version. Install iOS through Xcode.
- **Relay image**: `ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.26.0` and `:latest` for amd64 and arm64.

Desktop assets appear as each platform's build finishes.

[All changes since v1.25.0](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/compare/v1.25.0...v1.26.0)

# wisp-science v1.26.0 — GPUI 预览版下载

**从这一版开始，每次发布都会在 WebView 安装包旁边附上 macOS、Windows、Linux 三个平台的 GPUI 桌面端预览版。** 预览版换了新的外观，并补上了 WebView 的大部分页面。R 作图和 Python 一样会先做版面检查，Word 修订可以改表格里的文字，科研助理不用另开对话就能开始新的讨论。

## GPUI 桌面端预览版

- 发布附件里每个平台各有一个 GPUI 压缩包。无需安装，解压后直接运行。它有自己的名称、macOS bundle identifier 和数据目录，可以和 WebView 桌面端同时使用。
  - macOS：`wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_aarch64.app.zip` 与 `_x64.app.zip`，已签名并公证。
  - Windows：`wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_x64.zip`，已做 Authenticode 签名。
  - Linux：`wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_amd64.tar.gz`，未签名，需要 Vulkan 和 X11 或 Wayland 会话。
- **目前仍是预览版。** 官方支持的桌面端仍是 WebView 安装包，预览版也不会通过应用内更新推送；它的更新检查会打开发布页。详见 [GPUI 桌面端](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/gpui-desktop.md#preview-downloads) 和[功能对照表](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/gpui-parity.md)。
- WebView 的大部分功能已移植到预览版：研究旅程图、侧边面板、图片、归档、主机与定时任务、论文证据、导入、浏览器、中间区文档、旁路提问、SSH 主机上的解释器、终端输入与选择，以及提及。
- 换上了「实验记录」风格的外观：暖色纸张底色、衬线标题、阅读栏和统一的图标。每条记录开头用一行显示编号和时间，不再有侧边栏位。导入的 Codex 文件引用会显示为链接，回合结束后会显示模型的最终回答。
- Windows：修复了打开对话时的崩溃，窗口标题栏改由应用绘制，窗口控制按钮的图标也已修正。

## 作图、文档与科研助理

- **R 作图在交付前会先做检查。** `figure-style` 技能新增了 R 辅助函数 `save_checked_figure`：遇到空白或缺失的文件、文字重叠、标签超出边界时会拒绝保存；通过后会把每个面板裁成小图，方便 Agent 查看并修正。详见[技能](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/skills.md)。
- **Word 修订可以修改表格单元格里的文字**，嵌套表格也可以。`read_docx` 现在会标出每个段落所在的位置，例如 `table 1 row 2 cell 2`。修改表格结构、文本框和内容控件仍会被拒绝。详见 [DOCX 修订](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/docx-revisions.md)。
- **科研助理新增「新开讨论」按钮。** 它会清空模型记住的内容，之前的消息仍显示在分隔线上方。在微信里发送 `/new` 也能开始新讨论。详见[科研助理](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/research-assistant.md)。

## 修复

- 项目数据库损坏后，无论是从备份恢复还是重建为空，下次打开该项目时都会显示提示横幅，即使修复是在后台完成的。横幅会一直显示，直到你关闭它。详见[升级备份](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/blob/v1.26.0/docs/upgrade-backups.zh-CN.md)。
- 浏览器扩展（0.5.1）的侧边面板新增 **本会话内允许** 按钮，不会再每次调用浏览器工具都请求授权。已共享给项目的标签页只要还开着就保持共享，即使中途访问过 `chrome://extensions` 这样的页面。
- 通过 `delegate_tasks` 启动、且没有设置工具调用预算的 Agent，现在遵循「每轮最大 Agent 迭代次数」设置，不再固定为 100 轮。因达到该上限而停止的回合会显示 **打开设置** 按钮，可直接跳转到这项设置。注意：如果你把这个值设得低于 100，这些 Agent 会更早停止。

## 下载

- **macOS**：Apple Silicon 与 Intel 的 DMG，已签名并公证；兼容的安装支持应用内更新。
- **Windows**：MSI 与 NSIS 安装包，使用 SSL.com 证书签名。
- **Linux**：x86_64 与 aarch64 的 deb、AppImage 安装包。
- **GPUI 预览版**：上文列出的四个 `wisp-science-gpui_1.26.0_*` 压缩包。
- **移动端**：[签名 Android APK](https://github.com/xuzhougeng/wisp-science/releases/download/v1.26.0/wisp-science_1.26.0_android.apk) 可直接覆盖安装旧版本；iOS 通过 Xcode 安装。
- **中继镜像**：`ghcr.io/xuzhougeng/wisp-relay:1.26.0` 与 `:latest`，支持 amd64 和 arm64。

各平台构建完成后，桌面安装包会陆续出现在附件中。
